content.short: Token that every verified human can claim once a day in World App, with no insider allocation.
content.description: ORO is distributed equally to people rather than to investors. Anyone verified with World ID can claim it once a day inside World App, and World ID ensures each person claims only once. The whole supply goes to the community, with no share reserved for the team or backers. The token lives on World Chain, and its X account has around 76,000 followers.
content.meta: Claim ORO once a day in World App with World ID, a World Chain token shared equally among verified humans.
